title.zh: 算出一件补给的领先量
title.en: Measure the Lead to One Supply

brief.zh: 完成 supply_lead(player, target, rivals)。在开阔场地里，用最近对手到目标的步数减去自己的步数。没有对手时返回 None。
brief.en: Complete supply_lead(player, target, rivals). In an open arena, subtract your steps to the target from the closest rival’s steps. Return None when there are no rivals.

concept.zh: 先在多个对手中找最小距离
concept.en: Find the minimum distance among multiple rivals

hints.zh: distance 已算出开阔场地里的横向加纵向步数。
hints.en: distance already returns the horizontal plus vertical steps in an open arena.

hints.zh: 用第一个对手初始化最近距离，再比较剩下的位置。
hints.en: Start the nearest distance with the first rival, then compare the remaining positions.
